items.text: This @EPA & @GEFAloan award shows how GA & the gov can support projects that improve the quality of life for GA-02. Water treatment is a necessity but the costs can be prohibitive for smaller communities. I'm glad GA has resources for projects like this. https://t.co/dChHRfdJwO

Ag plays an important role in school meals by providing students w/ the nutrients needed to keep them healthy. @USDA’s  Farm to School Program helps promote the use of local foods in Child Nutrition Programs & make sure students are well fueled & ready to learn! https://t.co/rSAuAZIdJk

ATTN GA-02 producers/farmers! The 3/15 deadline to enroll in several @USDA programs is approaching: 
 
- The Ag Risk Coverage (ARC) Program
- The Price Loss Coverage (PLC) Program 
- The Pandemic Cover Crop Program
 
More info➡️https://t.co/A0LvRvgSJ9

In honor of Ntl Ag Month/Peanut Month, 10k jars of GA peanut butter were donated today to help to DC residents in need. This highlights the role that food banks & GA peanut farmers play in fighting hunger & promoting nutrition. #GA02AG 🥜 https://t.co/TrMUeWQ4Kl

With H.R. 7790, Congress is acting quickly to ensure that families have access to safe & affordable nutrition for their babies. It also helps prevent the sale of fake formula & provides Congress w/ data to address issues in the infant formula market. 
https://t.co/PsQM2QMUab

I supported the American Rescue Plan Act through which 15,000 more Middle & SW Georgians were able to get health insurance and save $800/person/year on avg. This helps Georgians get the affordable health care & treatment they need to fight diabetes, heart disease, cancer, & more. https://t.co/DbIKZgek83

I am deeply saddened to learn that two Fort Benning servicemembers died and three were injured during a training exercise in North Georgia yesterday. Their families and loved ones are in my thoughts and prayers.

Today, I supported the Inflation Reduction Act - historic legislation that will lower the cost of prescription drugs & health care premiums while addressing climate change & energy costs. Those making $400,000 or less will not see their taxes increase. https://t.co/RTQaJsi5YF

I'm pleased to announce that Columbus Consolidated Government has been awarded a grant of $400K from @HHSGov for expansion of substance abuse treatment in Muscogee County's Veterans Treatment Court. https://t.co/VGhze2UiQV

I supported the Respect for Marriage Act, which was approved in the House by a vote of 258-169. The Constitution guarantees equal treatment under the law regardless of race, sex, or national origin and the Respect for Marriage Act affirms this right. https://t.co/1T2vJ5k0Mj

I'm pleased to announce that 8 healthcare providers across GA’s 2nd District were awarded over $2 million through the American Rescue Plan Act by @HHSGov to improve access to COVID-19 vaccinations and reduce the strain on our clinics and hospitals. https://t.co/CKZDgW79SE

You can still enroll in an #ACA healthcare plan for 2023! Be sure to sign up by Jan. 15th for coverage starting Feb. 1st. This year, thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, Americans can continue to get help with premiums and save an average of $800 per year & $2,400 per family.

High-speed internet is fundamental to so many things in our day-to-day lives from resources that our students and teachers use to connecting doctors with patients. I was proud to specifically secure these funds for Donalsonville as part of the FY 2023 Appropriations bill.

Today, I was in Americus w/ Southwest GA Children's Alliance to present them w/ a check of $367,362 that I secured as part of the FY23 federal funding bill. They will use the funds to support their child abuse treatment & prevention programs across SW GA. https://t.co/PrlSZZnbLI

This afternoon, I visited Leesburg, GA to present the city with a ceremonial check of $949,146 in federal funding to install a pump station, clean water lines, and Ultraviolet Treatment System at its wastewater treatment plant. https://t.co/ENouuywyfD

Yesterday, I supported H.R. 815, the Removing Extraneous Loopholes Insuring Every Veteran Emergency (RELIEVE) Act. Our vets shouldn't second-guess seeking emergency medical care out of fear of costly bills when they enroll in the VA health care system. https://t.co/QrNKFXw8WW

GRANT ANNOUNCEMENT: The REACH program seeks to improve health, prevent diseases & reduce health disparities among ethnic groups w/ the highest risk of chronic disease. Programming includes improving nutrition, exercise & promoting the importance of immunizations.

Expectant Black mothers in the US can be up to 3x more likely to die from pregnancy-related causes. This is a challenge we can and must overcome. I'll continue to support programs that improve maternal health through housing, transportation & nutrition. #BlackMaternalHealthWeek

Each year, GA produces 100 million lbs of pecans w/ most production in Dougherty Co. Not only are these nuts good for our economy-they help provide nutrients for a healthy diet. On #NationalPecanDay we celebrate all that farmers do to keep GA the number one pecan producer.

I opposed the Majority's FY24 Ag Appropriations bill. The federal gov't should be a strong partner for small towns whose budgets can't meet the upfront costs of vital projects. Cuts will hurt the most vulnerable & blunt progress made to grow our economy. https://t.co/THc4eMaz6g

Mental illness affects millions of Americans, often going unseen & untreated. Stay ahead of your mental health by talking to a professional before mild symptoms intensify. If you or a loved one is experiencing a mental health crisis, contact the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988. https://t.co/rDLgkEsfix

To our brave veterans who served in combat & were discharged from service between 9/11/01 and 10/1/13, you are eligible to file for VA healthcare under the #PACTAct. Sign up today to secure your coverage! https://t.co/yh3FmlDFWA. Open enrollment ends at 11:59 PM EST on 9/30/2023. https://t.co/kZhzFGLzl2

This week I met w/ the @gsbacomm. We discussed the need for robust federal funding for Title I schools, child nutrition, mental health & students w/ disabilities. Congress should continue to be a strong supporter of schools who work hard to provide the best outcomes for students. https://t.co/OdxCrGyweL

Open enrollment or changes for ACA health coverage begins on November 1st. To be covered starting January 1, 2024, you must enroll before December 15, 2023. In GA, you can sign up through https://t.co/jpmJQa2NtA.

I opposed HR 4821, the FY24 Interior, Environment & Related Agencies funding bill. The bill was an exercise in partisan politics & draconian cuts to funding levels last seen in 1991. Read more in my statement below.
 https://t.co/15jrAZIcrV
